title: Top-level native conditional CSS leaves compose directives unlowered
head: dcd9f0ad4591be3b9ab5c1b5aa940c735698ac71
baselineNote: Whole-branch comparison initially failed because older uncommitted graph-slot additions are absent from HEAD. The variant-only dispatch guard and native fallback are byte-identical; this turn did not add the omission.

evidence.rust: 0183-output-maps-rust-focused-confirmed.log:6PASS/1FAIL; conditional case produces no lowered selector

cause: Top-level dispatch lowers only variant-rewritten media. Standard native media is retained with @compose still inside its child style; lower_css_directives receives no style definition. Independent of output-mapping additions and of BH0056 renderer forwarding.
next: Extend native conditional traversal while preserving unrelated native children and source order; verify media/supports/container/layer/starting-style, direct and graph-slot paths, native/Wasm and actual browser cascade/source origins. Do not blindly send arbitrary native child rules through a lowerer that rejects them.
